scope: RK3588 IPC P3 partial: four-arm motor communication and official left-follower initialization

per_motor_communication.method: Each arm joint motor ID 1-6 was enabled, read once, and explicitly disabled; no position target was sent.

invalid_gravity_trial.configuration: physical linear_4310 attached but software used no_gripper to avoid calibration
invalid_gravity_trial.interpretation: Not valid evidence for YAM gravity compensation because the software model omitted the physical gripper mass and inertia.
invalid_gravity_trial.shutdown_observation: Pinned i2rt v1.2.4 reproduced the control-thread/CAN-socket close race described by upstream PR 81.
invalid_gravity_trial.postcondition: Motor IDs 1-6 were explicitly disabled after the trial.

i2rt_shutdown_fix.upstream_status: official repository pull request 81, open when checked
i2rt_shutdown_fix.change: Retain and join the DMChain control thread before closing its CAN socket.
i2rt_shutdown_fix.deployment: Thin git bundle transferred over the LAN because the IPC submodule remote was a developer-host local path.
i2rt_shutdown_fix.result: The negative-file-descriptor shutdown exception did not recur in the official left-follower initialization.

official_left_follower_initialization.shutdown: zero-torque command, patched bounded thread join, then explicit motor-off replies for IDs 1-7

leader_handle_passive_readout.method: 100 passive encoder reads per handle at 100 Hz; leader arm motors were not enabled and encoder zero was not written.
leader_handle_passive_readout.interpretation: Both released-handle readings are close to the official near-zero expectation and the idle button bits were stable; no routine encoder re-zero is indicated.
leader_handle_passive_readout.remaining: Press transitions and active leader gravity-compensation still require supervised checks.

recording_regression_fix.observation: A full-suite run intermittently saw RecordingSession.episodes update before the atomic session.json checkpoint became visible.
recording_regression_fix.change: Write the candidate episode list to session.json before publishing the in-memory completion signal.
recording_regression_fix.verification: The focused checkpoint test passed 20 consecutive runs; the final full suite passed 263 tests with 2 skipped and 17 subtests.

passed: Four independent CAN mappings communicate with arm motor IDs 1-6 at 1 Mbit/s.
Left follower initializes with the correct standard YAM and linear_4310 model.
Left linear gripper auto-calibration returns a non-collapsed range.
Left follower numerical drift and CAN transport remain bounded for the measured 10-second window.
Patched shutdown completes without the observed CAN-socket race and all seven left-follower motors acknowledge OFF.
not_yet_passed: On-site tactile/visual confirmation that the left follower floats and holds as expected.
Right follower official initialization and gripper calibration.
Leader button press transitions and active gravity-compensation.
Single-pair and dual-pair low-amplitude synchronization, direction, pause and emergency-stop behavior.
A taught ready/home pose; no all-zero home command has been issued.
